针对近期 eMudhra 证书泄露风险，后端 CI 和镜像构建会移除拒绝策略中的四个根证书，并检查最终镜像，防止它们继续被 Java 信任；构建时同步记录基础镜像摘要和源码版本。Java 基线仍为 25。[代码变更][truststore-commit]、[Oracle 处置说明](https://ops.java/emudhra)
- 新增 MySQL/PostgreSQL 和 MinIO/RustFS 显式切换入口。默认仅检查，使用 `--apply` 才执行变更；切换流程增加并发锁、配置备份和失败恢复
- Java 构建与运行基线由 21 切换为 25；MySQL、PostgreSQL 两套 CI 验证矩阵同步使用 JDK 25。

Thanks to MangoIV, Peter Becich, Daniel Gasienica and Michael Xavier Well for their contributions!

Fixes for various bugs and updates added as well as some new array functions and array decoding functionality.

- **`better()` no longer takes `schema`.** Tables and relations come from the Drizzle instance (`db._.relations`, built by `drizzle({ client, relations })`). The options argument is optional, so `better(db)` works. A Drizzle instance without `relations` throws `No tables found on the Drizzle instance. ...`. Only tables in the relations config get a delegate. See [upgrading](https://better-drizzle.com/docs/guides/upgrading#3-pass-relations-to-drizzle-and-drop-schema-from-better).
